mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPLY ( REPLY_ID, MEMBER_ID, REPLY_CONTENT, CREATE_DATE, MODIFY_DATE, REPLY_STATUS, REF_ID, CODE ) VALUES ( SEQ_REPLY.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{replyContent}, SYSDATE, NULL, 'Y', #{refId}, #{code} )
mapper.update: UPDATE REPLY SET REPLY_CONTENT = #{replyContent}, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REPLY_ID = #{replyId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND REPLY_STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM REPLY WHERE REPLY_ID = #{replyId} AND REPLY_STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY WHERE REF_ID = #{refId} AND CODE = 'B' AND REPLY_STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT R.REPLY_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.REPLY_CONTENT, R.CREATE_DATE, R.REPLY_STATUS, R.REF_ID, R.CODE, M.NICKNAME AS WRITER_NICKNAME FROM REPLY R JOIN MEMBER M ON (R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) WHERE R.REPLY_STATUS = 'Y' AND ( /* A. 이번 페이지에 노출될 원댓글이거나 */ (R.CODE = 'B' AND R.REPLY_ID IN (SELECT REPLY_ID FROM REPLY WHERE REF_ID = #{refId} AND CODE = 'B' AND REPLY_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REPLY_ID ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY) ) OR /* B. 혹은 그 원댓글들에 딸려있는 대댓글 식구들이거나 */ (R.CODE = 'R' AND R.REF_ID IN (SELECT REPLY_ID FROM REPLY WHERE REF_ID = #{refId} AND CODE = 'B' AND REPLY_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REPLY_ID ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY) ) ) /* 정렬 알고리즘: 부모-자식 그룹화 -> 부모 먼저 -> 대댓글 작성순 */ ORDER BY (CASE WHEN R.CODE = 'B' THEN R.REPLY_ID ELSE R.REF_ID END) ASC, R.CODE ASC, R.REPLY_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE REPLY SET REPLY_STATUS = 'N' WHERE REPLY_ID = #{replyId}
